content.short: Orbit Protocol is a native liquidity hub on Blast that leverages its native yield to optimize lending.
content.description: Orbit Protocol is a premier decentralized liquidity and lending platform built natively for the Blast Layer 2 network. The protocol is specifically engineered to harness Blast's unique native yield mechanism, using it to subsidize interest rates for borrowers and enhance returns for suppliers. Users can deposit various digital assets to receive "oAssets," which represent their principal plus accrued interest, allowing for maximum capital efficiency. Orbit serves as a central hub for liquidity management, featuring professional-grade risk parameters and a robust architecture.
content.meta: Orbit Protocol offers decentralized lending and borrowing on Blast, optimized by native yield. Find Orbit and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
